description: Traffic Counts Studies by 15 Minute Bins is a dataset listed in City of Seattle open data portal (cos-data.seattle.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Seattle. This table provides traffic studies in 15 minutes bins and some statistics. The SDOT Traffic Counts group runs studies across the city to collect traffic volumes. Most studies are done with pneumatic tubes, but some come from video systems as well. Use the field studyid to match it with other tables for more information. Coverage: Seattle. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are counts, traffic counts. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: SDOT Traffic Counts Group. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-cos-data-seattle-gov-portal.
